compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- DD5 (continued): Unit tests for new logic include a behavioral parity assertion against the pre-existing local pre-commit gate logic in parse_test_index().
- Gap-analysis finding: standing parity test prevents grammar drift between local pre-commit gate and CI merge-tree gate (the exact regression class this story is designed to prevent).

## Implementation Notes

Create `tests/scripts/test-scan-red-markers-vs-parse-test-index-parity.sh`.

**Test approach (Given / When / Then)**:
- Given: a fixture `.test-index` containing the documented grammar variants drawn from the REVIEW-DEFENSE comment block at the top of `.test-index` AND from `plugins/dso/scripts/runners/bash-runner.sh:_RED_MARKER_MAP`:
  - source-side `path:[name]` (no space)
  - test-side `path [name]` (with space, after colon)
  - comma-separated test lists
  - malformed variants (space after source-side colon, embedded brackets)
- When: invoke parse_test_index from `plugins/dso/hooks/pre-commit-test-gate.sh` AND scan-red-markers.sh against the same fixture
- Then: the SET of detected RED markers (source, test, marker_name) is IDENTICAL between the two implementations

Test is behavioral, not snapshot — assert on the set of extracted tuples, not on stdout format.

Add `.test-index` RED marker `[test_red_marker_grammar_parity]` for `plugins/dso/scripts/scan-red-markers.sh`.

The parity test must PASS when run against T2's implementation. If it fails, T2's implementation has drifted from the local gate's grammar.

## File Impact

| Source file | Action | Tests | Class |
|-------------|--------|-------|-------|
| `tests/scripts/test-scan-red-markers-vs-parse-test-index-parity.sh` | create | (this IS the test) | needs-creation |
| `.test-index` | modify | n/a | n/a (marker only) |

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Parity test file exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-scan-red-markers-vs-parse-test-index-parity.sh
- [ ] Test compares output SET (not stdout) between parse_test_index and scan-red-markers.sh
  Verify: grep -qE 'parse_test_index|set.*comparison' tests/scripts/test-scan-red-markers-vs-parse-test-index-parity.sh
- [ ] After T2 lands, parity test passes
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-scan-red-markers-vs-parse-test-index-parity.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
On 3 consecutive opus failures: escalate to user
